  timestamp TIMESTAMP,  -- The timestamp for when the block was collated. Examples: '2026-09-01 00:00:11', '2026-09-01 00:00:23'
  miner VARCHAR,  -- The address of the beneficiary to whom the mining rewards were given. Examples: '0x4838b106fce9647bdf1e7877bf73ce8b0bad5f97', '0x396343362be2a4da1ce0c1c210945346fb82aa49'
  size BIGINT,  -- The size of this block in bytes. Examples: '1205', '148798'
  gas_limit BIGINT,  -- The maximum gas allowed in this block. Examples: '60000000', '59941408'
  gas_used BIGINT,  -- The total used gas by all transactions in this block. Examples: '0', '26185301'
  transaction_count BIGINT,  -- The number of transactions in the block. Examples: '227', '224'
  base_fee_per_gas BIGINT,  -- Protocol base fee per gas, which can move up or down. Examples: '49045353', '63138320'
  blob_gas_used BIGINT,  -- The total amount of blob gas consumed by transactions in the block. Examples: '0', '393216'
  excess_blob_gas BIGINT  -- A running total of blob gas consumed in excess of the target, prior to the block. This is used to set blob gas pricing. Examples: '178553567', '184505771'
